svg.title: Event-driven analytics architecture — URL shortener
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing the synchronous redirect path (User → Spring Boot → HTTP 308) and the asynchronous analytics path (Spring Boot → Kafka → Analytics Consumer → PostgreSQL), with a clear boundary separating the two flows.
svg.text: Analytics processing is asynchronous and does not affect redirect latency.
The HTTP 308 is returned before the event reaches Kafka.
